description: Point-in-time financial indicators for one A-share at a given trade_date. Returns the latest report visible AS OF that date (announce_date ≤ date; conservative 90-day fallback when announce_date is missing). Designed for backtests / AI agents to avoid look-ahead bias. ~25 fields incl. EPS / BPS / ROE / margins / revenue / net-income / equity.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

date.description: Trade date YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today

name: financials_pit
